$comment: MCP client/host configuration for Agent Drift.
Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/agent-drift with the absolute path to your checkout.
SECURITY: the --task-id value is the trust anchor. It is supplied here, by you, when
the gateway process is launched, and nothing the agent sends can change it. Register
the matching contract through the control plane BEFORE starting a session: an unknown
task fails closed and every call is denied with AD-E020.
COVERAGE: only tool calls that traverse this gateway are enforced. Any server your
host talks to directly, and any non-MCP capability, is outside Agent Drift's view.

$comment_custom_upstream: To guard your own MCP server instead of the bundled sandbox fixture, add
--upstream-command and one --upstream-arg per argument, and give the policy engine
a tool-to-operation mapping for your tools (see packages/agent_drift/policy.py,
DEFAULT_TOOL_SPECS). Operations are mapped by local configuration and never read
from a tool's own description or annotations.
